title: Drumming expressions and the T.O.B.A. circuit
summary: Moore says his face makes people laugh when he drums, then talks of T.O.B.A. touring and being stranded without a name attraction.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When you're drumming? When I'm drumming, it's a habit I guess. Sometimes I'm very confident I got that stereo to my eyeball look. From your menstrual days? Yeah. I got them menstrual days, what do you call it? T-O-B-A.
Yeah, I know what that stands for.

So when I'm drumming and I think I'm drumming naturally, I ain't doing nothing, but the folks looking at me laughing. So I catch myself and try to straighten up. First thing you know, I'm still drumming, I get right back in that, that funny look again and people look at me, always looking at me, see. When I'm drumming, I call myself drumming natural.
